headline: Midnight chaos: Gunfire, looting, and vandalism in Dhaka rampage
summary: Reports of widespread destruction and theft across the capital city during a midnight surge of violence.
details: A wave of violence swept through Dhaka at midnight, characterized by gunfire, looting, and widespread vandalism.
The rampage left several areas of the capital city in ruins, with reports of property destruction and theft of goods from various establishments.
Security forces are working to restore order as the city grapples with the aftermath of the midnight unrest.
The scale of the destruction has caused significant alarm among residents and business owners across the city.
caption:

A wave of violence swept through Dhaka at midnight, characterized by gunfire, looting, and widespread vandalism.

headline_marked: 10-year-old girl [[killed in Ctg as truck hits bike]]
headline: 10-year-old girl killed in Ctg as truck hits bike
summary: Three others, including two young children, were injured in the head-on collision in Patiya upazila on Sunday evening.
details: A 10-year-old girl was killed and three others injured after a truck collided with their motorcycle in Patiya upazila of Chattogram on Sunday evening.
The deceased has been identified as Pahela Barua, daughter of Nandan Barua, a resident of Baruapara in Kolagaon union.
The injured include Nandan Barua and his nephews, 7-year-old Partha Barua and 5-year-old Partha Barua, who were all traveling on the same motorcycle.
According to Inspector Nahid Hasan of the Kalarpol Police Outpost, the accident occurred around 6:15 PM at Kolagaon Kachari Pukurpar on the Panchuria-Kalarpol regional road.
The collision was a head-on crash between the motorcycle carrying four riders and a truck coming from the opposite direction.
Locals rescued the injured and rushed them to Chattogram Medical College Hospital, where doctors declared Pahela dead on arrival.
Police have seized the truck and detained the driver, identified as Ismail, for questioning.
caption:
A 10-year-old girl has been killed and three others injured in a tragic head-on collision in Chattogram.

A 10-year-old girl was killed and three others injured after a truck collided with their motorcycle in Patiya upazila of Chattogram on Sunday evening.

The deceased has been identified as Pahela Barua, daughter of Nandan Barua, a resident of Baruapara in Kolagaon union.

The injured include Nandan Barua and his nephews, 7-year-old Partha Barua and 5-year-old Partha Barua, who were all traveling on the same motorcycle.

According to Inspector Nahid Hasan of the Kalarpol Police Outpost, the accident occurred around 6:15 PM at Kolagaon Kachari Pukurpar on the Panchuria-Kalarpol regional road.

The collision was a head-on crash between the motorcycle carrying four riders and a truck coming from the opposite direction.

Locals rescued the injured and rushed them to Chattogram Medical College Hospital, where doctors declared Pahela dead on arrival.

Police have seized the truck and detained the driver, identified as Ismail, for questioning.
